decision: SINGLE-J native mixture-density cache replaces the earlier criterion-only proposal as a candidate design. The earlier lifecycle patch/note and all closed evidence remain unchanged.

native_cache.ON: Only non-boundary CODE_IsFluid slots use rho(J)=double(rhow)+(double(rho0)-double(rhow))/Jstage, then one float cast for Velrhop.w. Working periodic soil copies carry the same stage cache; they do not become additional native owners.
native_cache.predictor: Use the actual PoroJ half state already advanced and domain-validated by ComputeSymplecticPrePorosity / ComputeSymplecticPorosity(false,dt/2). Do not evolve density from Arc.
native_cache.corrector: Preview exactly: jhalf=current J; jfull=Jn; jfull+=dt*jhalf*theta. This matches the later commit's source expression/order without publishing half J as full or moving the J, kplastic, Code, position or pore-pressure commits.
native_cache.exclusion: Check double J finite and J>1-n0, double rho finite/positive and the original RhopOutMin/Max before the float cache cast; also reject a nonfinite/nonpositive float result. Do not clamp, change limits, bypass invalid J or retune material constants. Code tagging stays at its original location and the existing unconditional J validator remains.
native_cache.OFF: Null GPU j / CPU feedback=false selects the existing literal legacy predictor/corrector density arithmetic and original float range comparison. Observer-only remains OFF for this change. Source-level preservation is not a compiled bit-identity result.

Arc_and_walls.native: The feedback native main pair loop directly skips only its old Arc expression. PoroTheta, stress-rate, momentum, AV, ViscDt, load and Darcy work remain. Native Arc stays initialized zero; it is not a new physical mixture-density rate.
Arc_and_walls.fixed: Boundary Arc and its ViscDt work are unchanged; no whole Bound-Fluid loop is bypassed. CPU boundary predictor/corrector retain their original Arc integration and clamps literally. GPU retains its existing direct rho0 boundary writes. Dynamic wall-state reconstruction still writes rho0 in its original order: this is a fixed-wall marker/reference convention, not a claim CPU boundary w is rho0 at every integration stage or that ghost J represents physical wall mass.

qualification.MLS: Feedback dynamic-wall source qualification uses actual J inside the original support cutoff, independently of legacy w. An in-support nonfinite/J<=1-n0 source records the existing terminal query failure and cannot take the nearest-geometry retry. OFF scalar/vector MLS qualification is unchanged.
qualification.theta: Feedback accepts sources independently of w and validates actual J only after CODE/inactive-wall/support checks. A bad supported J makes theta nonfinite so the existing J-stage validator rejects; no immediate-throw or finite/unchanged partial raw-force result is promised. Out-of-support poison remains ignored.
qualification.unchanged: No wall release/removal, dry/wet rule, physical-near cutoff, public gravity admission, constitutive/plastic update or fixed-wall density unification.

physical_and_output_limits: Keep all current explicit J quadrature/inertia: V=V0*J and mi=V*rho(J). M0/rho_mix is not V0*J, and rho_dot=-(rho-rhow)*theta is not the old continuity formula.
Momentum, flexible confinement, reference top resultant/band inertia, FS/C, stress gradients, AV, HG, complete Darcy, dynamic damping and limiter formulas are not changed.

Native public Rhop becomes a float J-derived cache; PoroMixtureDensity remains its double J-derived ledger. Arc and Rhop differences are intentional semantics changes, not evidence that every exported field is bit-identical.

CPU/GPU gauges remain unported diagnostics: velocity/level use M0/w and force gauges use legacy density/stress weights without J/p. Projection may change their output; do not use them as J-based total force/reaction acceptance. No gauge implementation change is proposed.

Laminar/SPS, DDT, artificial stress, shifting, Shepard, legacy strip/contact quadrature and other forbidden combinations remain forbidden. A physical rho cache does not port their fixed-mass operators.
CPU boundary Arc and Visco0 fallback are not broadly sanitized. Direct field-only zero/negative-w poison rows are not complete physical integrator/finite-force admission claims.
